# AdrianParker.com

> Personal site of Adrian Parker, Wellington, New Zealand: blog posts on product management, finance, software, investment and travel, concert reviews, and a few small browser-based apps.

No major AI provider has confirmed it reads llms.txt; this file is a cheap courtesy, not a promise.

## Sections

- [About](https://www.adrianparker.com/about/): who writes this site
- [Posts](https://www.adrianparker.com/posts/): every blog post, newest first
- [Gigs](https://www.adrianparker.com/gigs/): concert reviews, with setlists and photos
- [Apps](https://www.adrianparker.com/apps/): browser-based tools, including Gig History (every gig attended) and an EXIF Viewer
- [Sitemap](https://www.adrianparker.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Feed](https://www.adrianparker.com/feed.xml)
